findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "whatsapp-wyjbao" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_getUserInfo, post_getProfilePicUrl, post_getAbout · Public sink: post_getUserInfo, post_getProfilePicUrl, post_getAbout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_getUserInfo, post_getProfilePicUrl, post_getAbout · Public sink: post_getUserInfo, post_getProfilePicUrl, post_getAbout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
